stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 40% acid be mixed with a solution containing 78% acid to obtain a mixture that is 54% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{78 - 54}{54 - 40} = \dfrac{24}{14} = 12:7$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 2).
